function.name: swarm_remember
function.description: Store a private note in the swarm's confidential shared memory. Other agents can benefit from it through synthesized answers but can never read it verbatim.

text.description: The fact, preference, plan or observation to remember.

function.name: swarm_recall
function.description: Ask the swarm's shared memory a question. Returns an answer synthesized across every member's private notes plus how many members contributed (counts only, never who or what they wrote).
